affirmations.text: I soften where the world wants me to bonk harder.
My breath is slow, my timeline is optional.
I let loud noise float away like a cloud — I stay meadow-calm.
Right now is enough. I don't have to earn my peace.
Rest is not lazy — it's how peaceful warriors recharge.
I bonk stress with play, not panic.
One minute of silly bonks clears a whole hour of static.
I bonk things that need bonking — gently, on purpose, with love.
Laughter is a bonk the soul actually asked for.
When the chart screams, I breathe first and bonk second.
I belong to the fam — peace spreads when we show up for each other.
I share good vibes like lo-fi on a Sunday — freely and on repeat.
Someone near me deserves a peaceful bonk today — I can be that person.
We rise together — no one bonks alone in the Bonga way.
I am already enough — my worth isn't tied to the last candle.
I talk to myself like I'd talk to a sleepy Bonga — kind and patient.
My body knows the pace. Slow is the speed limit, and that's beautiful.
Gratitude is my quiet superpower — one small thank-you shifts the whole day.
Yesterday's bonks don't define today's peace — I start fresh.
I raise my frequency one breath, one stretch, one good bonk at a time.
Cosmic balance lives in me — inhale peace, exhale the noise.
I carry meadow energy into loud rooms.
Peace, love, good bonks — that's the frequency I'm on today.
I move like Tai Chi clouds — soft edges, steady center.
Today can be 1% more peaceful — and that's a win worth celebrating.
I don't take the chaos too seriously — humor is part of my peace practice.
Saying no is a bonk for my boundaries — and my boundaries are sacred.
I witness others without fixing them — presence is the peaceful bonk.
Morning me sets the vibe — I choose calm before the timeline wakes up.
Peace, love, good bonks — I whisper it until my nervous system believes it.
Stillness is not empty — it's where my best ideas bonk gently into view.
I close tabs in my mind the way the sun closes the day — slowly, with color.
I let worry flow downstream — I stay on the peaceful bank.
A little dance bonk resets my whole nervous system — permission granted.
I stretch before I scroll — my body gets the first bonk of the day.
Memes are medicine when taken with breath — I dose responsibly.
I turn down the volume on drama and up the volume on lo-fi peace.
New faces in the fam deserve a warm bonk — I lead with welcome energy.
Someone else's win is my win — I celebrate without keeping score.
I listen like Tai Chi listens to breath — fully, without rushing to fix.
Good vibes are contagious — I'm patient zero for peaceful bonks today.
Pause is power — I don't owe anyone a rushed reply.
Small steps count — one peaceful choice stacks into a whole season.
I can be honest about hard days and still be gentle with myself.
Sleepy Bonga energy is valid — rest is part of raising the frequency.
I absorb sunlight like a meadow — warmth is part of my signal.
The right song is a frequency shift — I curate my soundtrack on purpose.
Ten minutes outside retunes me — nature is the original Bonga playlist.
I set intention before I set notifications — my vibe leads the day.
I end the day soft — moonlight is a permission slip to rest.
I sip tea before I sip drama — warm bonks only.
A virtual hug is still a bonk of love — I send one freely.
I am a lighthouse on confusing days — steady, not loud.
I align with stars I cannot see — trust is part of the frequency.
I tend my inner garden — weeds get compassion, flowers get time.
